raw_input:
New campaign for Nike Air Max 90 dropping this summer. 
We want something that feels alive — bold, urban, youthful. 
Think street courts, golden hour light, motion blur. 
Colors should lean into orange and white with dark accents. 
Audience is 18-28, city dwellers who live in their sneakers.
